Senses.Explanation: Freely following the course is a fixed evaluative formula for unhindered comportment. Masters reverse and repeat its halves, pair it with being free and unencumbered, and set it after the thorough integration of teaching and worldly affairs. Feiyin Tongrong playfully reverses “buoyant and unforced” and “unforced and buoyant” before trampling the old holy monk. Gaofeng Yuanmiao pairs the formula with being unconstrained east, west, north, and south. Gaofeng's Essentials joins it to being free, unencumbered, dry, and clean after penetrating both teaching and worldly distinctions. The formula therefore evaluates comportment publicly; it is not merely an adverb meaning ‘automatically.’
